'''Morrigan''' was the eighth Queen of [[Andor]], succeeding Queen [[Telaisien]] in {{fy|1103}}.

==History==
It is not known if Morrigan was Telaisien's daughter, but it is known that she was also a descendant of Queen [[Ishara Casalain]], the founder of the kingdom of Andor.

Morrigan ruled for eleven years (FY 1103-[[FY 1114|1114]]) and was succeeded by Queen [[Lyndelle]].
